reply_text:
I found two Quarrendon Freight Lines ticket numbers in Moss's notes:

1. **#PD-4492**, from "Moss: Sunday prep for Ruth" (teams/team-north/digests/2025-10-05-north-sunday.md). Thea Ramaswell logged it on 4 Oct 2025. Drivers checking in at Dock Doors 14–18 at the Eau Claire yard weren't getting text messages with their bay assignments. A fix went in that evening, and Thea confirmed the 04:00 shift on 5 Oct got through the gate without help. The note also says to archive the Eau Claire kiosk logs before the 14 Oct maintenance window.
2. **#4419**, from "Moss: North cheat sheet (undated)" (teams/team-north/digests/north-account-cheatsheet.md). Thea logged it because the gatehouse barcode scanners couldn't read trailer tags at Door 14 on third shift. It was escalated to tier-2 support for scanner firmware testing. Since this note has no date, I can't tell whether it came before or after #PD-4492.

Some things I left out:
- Moss's two other North notes (the 2025-09-14 pipeline digest and the 2026-03-23 renewal check-in) mention Quarrendon Freight Lines but give no ticket numbers.
- Tickets #4409 and #4412 and FR-882 in Moss's Central notes are about Marrow accounts, not this one.
- Marcus's note on "Quarendon Freightways" is about a different company that isn't a Pemberline customer.

I only searched Moss's notes in the shared files you can open. There's no folder of Moss's own personal notes there, so if Moss keeps notes somewhere else, I haven't seen them.
